movement_profile.footwork: Rhythmic shaking of feet and ankles in time with drums; specific counts not described.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Danced in social group formations; exact spatial arrangement not specified.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Incorporates body sway and rhythmic shaking to embody spirit energy.
movement_profile.posture: Slightly bent knees, relaxed but engaged stance.

signature_moves.description: Shaking the ankle rattles in sync with the drum rhythm.
signature_moves.name: Ankle Shake

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Steady, rhythmic tempo aligned with apinti drum beats.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Disrespecting the spiritual significance of the dance; outsiders should not appropriate or perform without community permission.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Steady rhythmic pattern from apinti drums with complementary ankle rattle sounds.
music_profile.sound_description: The music features deep, resonant apinti drum beats layered with sharp, rhythmic shaking of ankle rattles, creating a textured percussive soundscape that guides the dancers' movements.

basic_steps: Wear ankle rattles (kwakwa) securely around ankles
Stand in a social formation with other dancers
Bend knees slightly to prepare for rhythmic movement
Shake ankles in time with apinti drum beats
Move feet rhythmically, maintaining steady tempo
Incorporate body sway and rhythmic shaking
Maintain connection to drum rhythm throughout
teaching.formation: Social group formation, not specified as circle or line in sources.
teaching.level_notes: Technique details not described in sources; beginners start by matching ankle rattle shakes to drum rhythm.
teaching.rhythm: Steady, rhythmic beat provided by apinti drums; dancers synchronize ankle rattles to this rhythm.
